reuse.why: Adds the flag to the existing shared isExcludedFromBulkActions predicate and getBulkActionCategories selector that all month-wide actions already use.

duplication.why: The hidden rule is changed once in the predicate; each action only threads the flag through.

placement.why: All edits are in budget/actions.ts where the exclusion rule and the month-wide actions live.

scope.why: Only the predicate, the selector and the six month-wide action signatures change.

maintainability.why: A single named parameter on the shared predicate is clean, though the same optional field and default is repeated on six action signatures and the income check stays duplicated per action as before.
